# A-S Medication Solutions

> A-S Medication Solutions delivers FDA/DEA-compliant point-of-care dispensing and pharmacy solutions to improve medication adherence and clinical outcomes.

With 35+ years of experience, A-S Medication Solutions provides comprehensive medication management platforms including point-of-care dispensing, the HealthAlly chronic disease management system, full-service pharmacy, and government contracting solutions. The company serves clinics, healthcare providers, and government entities with automated, compliant medication delivery systems.

## Key Topics

- Point-of-Care Dispensing
- Medication Adherence
- HealthAlly Platform
- FDA/DEA Compliance
- Pharmacy Automation
- Chronic Disease Management
- Inventory Management
- Clinical Programs
- Government Contracting
- On-Site Dispensing
- Mail-Order Pharmacy
- DSCSA Exemption
- Healthcare Technology
- Medication Management

## Core Solutions

- [Point-of-Care Dispensing](https://www.a-smeds.com/point-of-care-dispensing): Point-of-care dispensing with prepackaged medications, barcoding, and automation.
- [HealthAlly: Chronic Disease Management](https://www.a-smeds.com/healthally): HealthAlly platform for chronic disease management: diabetes, cardiac, pulmonary.
- [Pharmacy Solutions](https://www.a-smeds.com/pharmacy): Full-service pharmacy solutions for closed and open retail pharmacy needs.
- [Our Solutions Overview](https://www.a-smeds.com/oursolutions): Overview of ASM solutions: HealthAlly, point-of-care, pharmacy, and mail order.

## Government & Contracting

- [Government Contracting](https://www.a-smeds.com/governmentcontracting): Government contracting for federal, state, and local pharmaceutical procurement.
